    /\ token = 0
    /\ seated = [l \in Lobbies |-> 0]
    /\ cap = [l \in Lobbies |-> 2]
    /\ players = 4

Seat(n, l) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ players > 0
    /\ seated[l] + 1 <= cap[l]
    /\ seated' = [seated EXCEPT ![l] = seated[l] + 1]
    /\ players' = players - 1
    /\ token' = (n + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

Raise(n, l) ==

    /\ cap[l] < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![l] = cap[l] + 1]
    /\ token' = (n + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seated, players>>

Lower(n, l) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ cap[l] > seated[l]
    /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![l] = cap[l] - 1]
    /\ token' = (n + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seated, players>>

Pass(n) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ token' = (n + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seated, cap, players>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, l \in Lobbies : Seat(n, l)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, l \in Lobbies : Raise(n, l)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, l \in Lobbies : Lower(n, l)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Pass(n)

A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker manages several game lobbies arranged in a
ring. A single circulating token grants whichever node currently holds it the
exclusive right to seat one waiting player or to adjust a lobby's capacity; no
node acts without the token. Each lobby has a current seated headcount and a
current capacity that the operator may raise or lower at runtime. The token
holder may seat a player into a lobby only when doing so keeps the headcount
within that lobby's current capacity, and it may lower a lobby's capacity only
down to (never below) its current headcount. The token is then passed to the
next node in the ring. Exactly one token exists at all times.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every lobby's seated headcount is always less than or equal to its current capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od8m5p2t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Members == {"m1", "m2", "m3"}
Total == 3

VARIABLES free, enrolled, votes, kind, alive

vars == <<free, enrolled, votes, kind, alive>>

Kinds == {"none", "enroll", "drop"}

Init ==
    /\ free = Total
    /\ enrolled = 0
    /\ votes = [m \in Members |-> "none"]
    /\ kind = "none"
    /\ alive = [m \in Members |-> TRUE]

Open(k) ==
    /\ kind = "none"
    /\ k \in {"enroll", "drop"}
    /\ (k = "enroll" => free > 0)
    /\ (k = "drop" => enrolled > 0)
    /\ kind' = k
    /\ votes' = [m \in Members |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, enrolled, alive>>

Crash(m) ==
    /\ alive[m]
    /\ Cardinality({o \in Members : alive[o]}) >= 3
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, enrolled, votes, kind>>

Vote(m, v) ==
    /\ kind # "none"
    /\ alive[m]
    /\ votes[m] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![m] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, enrolled, kind, alive>>

Yeses == {m \in Members : votes[m] = "yes"}

Commit ==
    /\ kind # "none"
    /\ Cardinality(Yeses) >= 2
    /\ IF kind = "enroll"
       THEN /\ free' = free - 1
            /\ enrolled' = enrolled + 1
       ELSE /\ free' = free + 1
            /\ enrolled' = enrolled - 1
    /\ kind' = "none"
    /\ votes' = [m \in Members |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED alive

Abort ==
    /\ kind # "none"
    /\ Cardinality(Yeses) < 2
    /\ \A m \in Members : alive[m] => votes[m] # "none"
    /\ kind' = "none"
    /\ votes' = [m \in Members |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, enrolled, alive>>

Next ==
    \/ \E k \in {"enroll", "drop"} : Open(k)
    \/ \E m \in Members : Crash(m)
    \/ \E m \in Members, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(m, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ free \in 0..Total
    /\ enrolled \in 0..Total
    /\ votes \in [Members -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ kind \in Kinds
    /\ alive \in [Members -> BOOLEAN]

Conservation ==
    free + enrolled = Total

popular course. Every enrollment or drop must first pass a quorum vote: three
registrar committee members each cast a yes/no vote on the pending request, and

    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ cmd' = NONE

Issue(r, c) ==

    /\ cmd = NONE
    /\ cmd' = [chute |-> c, ep |-> epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, load, alive>>

DiscardStale ==
    /\ cmd # NONE
    /\ cmd.ep # epoch
    /\ cmd' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, load, alive>>

Route ==
    /\ cmd # NONE
    /\ cmd.ep = epoch
    /\ load[cmd.chute] < Cap
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![cmd.chute] = load[cmd.chute] + 1]
    /\ cmd' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, alive>>

    /\ load[c] > 0
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![c] = load[c] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cmd, alive>>

    /\ Cardinality({x \in Routers : alive[x]}) >= 2
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, load, cmd>>

    \/ \E r \in Routers, c \in Chutes : Issue(r, c)
    \/ DiscardStale
    \/ Route
    \/ \E c \in Chutes : Collect(c)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Crash(r)

nl:
An airport baggage router sends bags to a set of destination chutes, each with a
bounded holding capacity. The routing table is reconfigured from time to time:
each reconfiguration installs a new routing plan under a freshly incremented
epoch number, and a router node will only act on the current epoch, discarding
any routing command stamped with a stale epoch. A router node may crash silently
and stop participating, but any bag it was about to route is not counted until
delivery actually commits. A bag is placed into a chute only if that chute still
has room. Bags may also be removed from a chute as they are collected.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of bags held in any chute never exceeds that chute's capacity.

Stations == {0, 1, 2}
Cars == {"a", "b"}

vars == <<token, sealed, sealCount, msgs>>

    /\ token = 0
    /\ sealed = [c \in Cars |-> FALSE]
    /\ sealCount = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ msgs = {}

Request(s, c) ==
    /\ token = s
    /\ [st |-> s, car |-> c] \notin msgs
    /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {[st |-> s, car |-> c]}
    /\ token' = (s + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED <<sealed, sealCount>>

DeliverSeal(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ ~ sealed[m.car]
    /\ sealed' = [sealed EXCEPT ![m.car] = TRUE]
    /\ sealCount' = [sealCount EXCEPT ![m.car] = sealCount[m.car] + 1]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED token

DropStale(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ sealed[m.car]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, sealed, sealCount>>

Pass(s) ==
    /\ token = s
    /\ token' = (s + 1) % 3
    /\ UNCHANGED <<sealed, sealCount, msgs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Stations, c \in Cars : Request(s, c)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : DeliverSeal(m)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : DropStale(m)
    \/ \E s \in Stations : Pass(s)

    /\ token \in Stations
    /\ sealed \in [Cars -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ sealCount \in [Cars -> 0..2]
    /\ msgs \subseteq [st : Stations, car : Cars]

nl:
A car-wash conveyor line moves cars past several wash stations arranged in a
ring. A single circulating token grants the holding station the exclusive right
to apply the final protective wax seal to a car. Applying the seal is
irreversible: once a car has been sealed it must never be sealed again (a second
coat ruins the finish). Stations request a seal by posting a request message;
messages travel over an unordered bus and may be delivered in any order, so a
station validates each request against the car's current state before acting. A
station only holds the token briefly, then passes it to the next station in the
ring.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No car is ever sealed more than once.

EXTENDS Integers, Sequences

Total == 3
QMax == 2

VARIABLES available, reserved, queue, worker

vars == <<available, reserved, queue, worker>>

Init ==
    /\ available = Total
    /\ reserved = 0
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ worker = "idle"

Enqueue ==
    /\ Len(queue) < QMax
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, "req")
    /\ UNCHANGED <<available, reserved, worker>>

Backpressure ==
    /\ Len(queue) >= QMax
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Pick ==
    /\ worker = "idle"
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ available > 0
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ worker' = "busy"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<available, reserved>>

Fulfill ==
    /\ worker = "busy"
    /\ available' = available - 1
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ worker' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED queue

DropEmpty ==
    /\ worker = "idle"
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ available = 0
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<available, reserved, worker>>

Return ==
    /\ reserved > 0
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ available' = available + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, worker>>

Next ==
    \/ Enqueue
    \/ Backpressure
    \/ Pick
    \/ Fulfill
    \/ DropEmpty
    \/ Return

    /\ available \in 0..Total
    /\ reserved \in 0..Total
    /\ queue \in Seq({"req"})
    /\ Len(queue) <= QMax
    /\ worker \in {"idle", "busy"}

A library book reservation system holds a fixed number of copies of a title.
Patron reservation requests enter a bounded work queue; when the queue is full
the system applies backpressure and refuses new requests rather than dropping a
copy. A background fulfillment worker may be slow but never fails: it drains
requests from the queue at its own pace, and each fulfilled request moves one
copy from the available pool to the reserved pool. A return moves a copy back
from reserved to available. Copies are never created or destroyed by any of
these operations.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of available copies plus the number of reserved copies always equals the fixed total number of copies.

            /\ free' = free + 1

    /\ UNCHANGED alive

    /\ pend[a] # NONE
    /\ pend[a].exp # enrolled

nl:
A university course-registration system tracks a fixed number of seats using two
shared registers: one counting enrolled students and one counting free seats.
Registration agents update the enrolled register with a compare-and-swap: an

---- MODULE W4Od16m5p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets

Members == {"p1", "p2", "p3"}
Vals == {1, 2}
MaxCommits == 3

VARIABLES rec, ver, log, votes, prop, alive

vars == <<rec, ver, log, votes, prop, alive>>

NONE == [val |-> 0, base |-> 0]

Init ==
    /\ rec = 0
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ log = <<>>
    /\ votes = [m \in Members |-> "none"]
    /\ prop = NONE
    /\ alive = [m \in Members |-> TRUE]

Propose(v) ==
    /\ prop = NONE
    /\ ver < MaxCommits
    /\ prop' = [val |-> v, base |-> ver]
    /\ votes' = [m \in Members |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, ver, log, alive>>

Vote(m, b) ==
    /\ prop # NONE
    /\ alive[m]
    /\ votes[m] = "none"
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![m] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, ver, log, prop, alive>>

Yeses == {m \in Members : votes[m] = "yes"}

Commit ==
    /\ prop # NONE
    /\ Cardinality(Yeses) >= 2
    /\ prop.base = ver
    /\ rec' = prop.val
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ log' = Append(log, prop.val)
    /\ prop' = NONE
    /\ votes' = [m \in Members |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED alive

Reject ==
    /\ prop # NONE
    /\ \/ (Cardinality(Yeses) >= 2 /\ prop.base # ver)
       \/ (Cardinality(Yeses) < 2 /\ \A m \in Members : alive[m] => votes[m] # "none")
    /\ prop' = NONE
    /\ votes' = [m \in Members |-> "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, ver, log, alive>>

Crash(m) ==
    /\ alive[m]
    /\ Cardinality({x \in Members : alive[x]}) >= 3
    /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, ver, log, votes, prop>>

Done ==
    /\ ver = MaxCommits
    /\ prop = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E v \in Vals : Propose(v)
    \/ Done
    \/ \E m \in Members, b \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(m, b)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Reject
    \/ \E m \in Members : Crash(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ rec \in {0} \cup Vals
    /\ ver \in 0..MaxCommits
    /\ log \in Seq(Vals)
    /\ votes \in [Members -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ prop \in [val : {0} \cup Vals, base : 0..MaxCommits]
    /\ alive \in [Members -> BOOLEAN]

    Len(log) > 0 => rec = log[Len(log)]

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser maintains one shared dispensing record per
patient. Each proposed update to the record must win a quorum vote from three
pharmacist stations before it is applied. To prevent a lost update, a proposal
carries the record version it was based on; the update commits only if a majority
of pharmacists vote yes and the record is still at that base version, otherwise
the proposal is rejected and must be retried against the fresh value. Each commit
writes the new value into the record and appends it to the record's audit log.
Any one pharmacist station may crash silently and stop voting, but a majority of
the remaining stations can still reach quorum.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The current value of the dispensing record always equals the most recently appended entry in its audit log, so no committed update is ever silently overwritten.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m7p3t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Sectors == {"s1", "s2"}
Drones == {"d1", "d2"}
NONE == "none"

AdminBudget == 2

VARIABLES owner, claim, pend, budget

vars == <<owner, claim, pend, budget>>

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Sectors |-> NONE]
    /\ claim = [d \in Drones |-> NONE]
    /\ pend = [d \in Drones |-> NONE]
    /\ budget = AdminBudget

BeginClaim(d, s) ==
    /\ claim[d] = NONE
    /\ pend[d] = NONE
    /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![d] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, claim, budget>>

CasClaim(d) ==
    /\ pend[d] # NONE
    /\ claim[d] = NONE
    /\ owner[pend[d]] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![pend[d]] = d]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![d] = pend[d]]
    /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![d] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED budget

CasFail(d) ==
    /\ pend[d] # NONE
    /\ owner[pend[d]] # NONE
    /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![d] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, claim, budget>>

Release(d) ==
    /\ claim[d] # NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![claim[d]] = NONE]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![d] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pend, budget>>

AdminOverride(s, d) ==
    /\ budget > 0
    /\ owner[s] # NONE
    /\ owner[s] # d
    /\ claim[d] = NONE
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = d]
    /\ claim' = [x \in Drones |-> IF x = d THEN s
                                  ELSE IF x = owner[s] THEN NONE
                                  ELSE claim[x]]
    /\ budget' = budget - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED pend

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones, s \in Sectors : BeginClaim(d, s)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : CasClaim(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : CasFail(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Release(d)
    \/ \E s \in Sectors, d \in Drones : AdminOverride(s, d)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Sectors -> Drones \cup {NONE}]
    /\ claim \in [Drones -> Sectors \cup {NONE}]
    /\ pend \in [Drones -> Sectors \cup {NONE}]
    /\ budget \in 0..AdminBudget

Coherent ==
    /\ \A d \in Drones : claim[d] # NONE => owner[claim[d]] = d
    /\ \A s \in Sectors : owner[s] # NONE => claim[owner[s]] = s

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Coherent
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm divides the fire perimeter into sectors, and
each sector must be watched by at most one drone. Ownership of a sector is held
in a per-sector register. A drone claims a free sector with a compare-and-swap:
it succeeds only if the sector register still reads free, at which point the
register records the drone and the drone records the sector. A drone may release
its sector, clearing both sides. A privileged mission admin may override an
assignment, forcibly moving a sector from its current drone to another drone,
and must update both the sector register and the two drones' records so the swarm
stays coherent.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A sector's register and its watching drone always agree - every drone's recorded sector points back to that drone in the sector's register, and vice versa - so no sector is ever doubly allocated.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od6m6p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences

Controllers == {"c1", "c2"}
NONE == "none"
Lease == 2
MaxTime == 4
Vals == {1, 2}
MaxWrites == 3

VARIABLES clock, holder, expiry, rec, log

vars == <<clock, holder, expiry, rec, log>>

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ expiry = 0
    /\ rec = 0
    /\ log = <<>>

Acquire(c) ==
    /\ \/ holder = NONE
       \/ clock >= expiry
    /\ holder' = c
    /\ expiry' = clock + Lease
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, rec, log>>

Write(c, v) ==
    /\ holder = c
    /\ clock < expiry
    /\ Len(log) < MaxWrites
    /\ rec' = v
    /\ log' = Append(log, v)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, holder, expiry>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxTime
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, rec, log>>

Idle ==
    /\ clock = MaxTime
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Idle
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Acquire(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, v \in Vals : Write(c, v)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxTime
    /\ holder \in Controllers \cup {NONE}
    /\ expiry \in 0..(MaxTime + Lease)
    /\ rec \in {0} \cup Vals
    /\ log \in Seq(Vals)

NoLostUpdate ==
    Len(log) > 0 => rec = log[Len(log)]

An elevator bank in a skyscraper coordinates its cars through one shared dispatch
record. To change the record a controller must first hold a time-limited lease:
acquiring the lease stamps it with the controller's id and an expiry a fixed
number of ticks in the future. Only the current lease holder may write, and only
while its lease has not expired; each write stores the new value and appends it

rather than allowed to clobber a newer value.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The dispatch record's current value always equals the last entry appended to its audit log, so no committed write is ever lost to a stale lease holder.

spec_text:

EXTENDS Integers

Bays == {"b1", "b2"}

    /\ coarse' = w
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, printed, msgs>>

AcquireFine(w, p) ==

    /\ fine[p] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![p] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, printed, msgs>>

Print(w, m) ==

    /\ fine[m.pr] = w
    /\ printed[m.job] = 0
    /\ printed' = [printed EXCEPT ![m.job] = printed[m.job] + 1]
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine>>

DropDone(m) ==
    /\ m \in msgs
    /\ printed[m.job] > 0
    /\ msgs' = msgs \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, printed>>

ReleaseFine(w, p) ==
    /\ fine[p] = w
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![p] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, printed, msgs>>

ReleaseCoarse(w) ==
    /\ coarse = w
    /\ \A p \in Printers : fine[p] # w
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, printed, msgs>>

    \/ \E w \in Workers : AcquireCoarse(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, p \in Printers : AcquireFine(w, p)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, m \in msgs : Print(w, m)
    \/ \E m \in msgs : DropDone(m)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, p \in Printers : ReleaseFine(w, p)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : ReleaseCoarse(w)

    /\ fine \in [Printers -> Workers \cup {NONE}]

nl:
A print-shop job spooler must actually print each job at most once - printing is
irreversible, and a duplicate print wastes toner and paper. Print commands are
submitted over an unordered channel and accumulate in a command set, so they may
be picked up in any order and the same job may appear more than once. To print, a
worker takes locks hierarchically: first the coarse spooler lock, then, only
while holding it, the fine lock on the target printer. Holding both, the worker
executes a pending command only if that job has not already been printed;
commands for jobs that are already done are discarded. Locks are released in
reverse order.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No job is ever printed more than once.

Two independent matchmaker instances, A and B, share one bounded intake queue of
players waiting for a ranked match; when the queue is full the system applies
backpressure and admits no more players. The instances also share a single ranked
match server, a critical resource that only one instance may use at a time. To
form a match an instance must first acquire the shared server, which marks it as
the server's owner and as being in the critical section; while it holds the server
it pulls a waiting player from the queue. When done it releases the server,
clearing both the ownership and its critical-section flag so the other instance
may take it.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Any instance in the critical section is exactly the recorded owner of the match server, so the two instances never use the server at the same time.
